# Breinscope Consultants Limited

> Breinscope Consultants Limited is a Kenyan-owned development consultancy, first registered in 2002 and headquartered in Nairobi, Kenya. It provides research, monitoring, evaluation and learning (MEL), baseline surveys, capacity building, strategic planning and programme design across 11 sectors for governments, multilateral and bilateral development agencies, NGOs and the private sector in East and Central Africa. It has delivered 200+ projects.

Key facts:

- Legal name: Breinscope Consultants Limited (registered 2002; limited liability company since 27 June 2007)
- Headquarters: Office Suite 26, 3rd Floor, Diani Road, Off Ole Dume Road, Nairobi, Kenya
- Offices: Nairobi (HQ) and Kisumu, Kenya; Mogadishu, Somalia; Kigali, Rwanda; Juba, South Sudan (through partner entity GMI Training & Consultancy Ltd)
- Contact: info@breinscope.co.ke, +254 729 325577, https://breinscope.co.ke/contact
- Sectors: Agriculture & Rural Development; Climate Change, Environment & NRM; Energy and Power Systems; Water and Sewerage; Rural and Urban Infrastructure; Road and Transportation; Education and Skills Development; Digital Development; Human Capital Consulting; Global Health and WASH; Governance, Social & Economic Development
- Clients and partners include: World Bank, IFC, USAID, KfW, GIZ, UNICEF, UNDP, IFAD, African Development Bank, European Commission, Sida, WHO, IOM, JICA, African Capacity Building Foundation, CARE Kenya, Save the Children, World Vision
- Quality: Quality Management System following ISO 9001 principles
